sections.state: A FREE rider, because TST-0656's Pro grant only appears at FREE. Enable the whole-app fake trainer in debug settings and restart. On Android choose the Trainer Capability Override; on iOS choose Mock trainer capability for feature states and Mock failure mode for refusals. For each real-trainer comparison, turn the iOS mock off and restart, or set Android's global override Off, before connecting the KICKR.

bench: The other platform's build on a second device
before: To share the Bluetooth log: Settings → Equipment → Bluetooth Diagnostics → Share.
Developer · Tier override → Reset to real entitlements, on a store account with no purchase. The rider has an FTP, a weight, and an LTHR that is not a round fraction of Max HR.

Settings → Developer · Trainer: **Use mock trainer** on. **Mock trainer capability** sets Data-only, No Control Point or Feature read timeout; **Mock failure mode** sets Refuses control or Refuses once. Fully close and reopen after each change, then reconnect. For the KICKR, turn Use mock trainer off and restart.

later.text: Connect a heart-rate strap, or Mock HRM Strap. HR-Zone and Zone Ride need one.
The other platform's debug build on a second device, for the comparisons across platforms. Screenshot every screen on both platforms as you go.
Open the parity gallery captures. Record any difference between the platforms against the TASK-0843 gallery keys.
The KICKR, or another trainer that accepts control, switched on nearby.

Two riders in the household with different colours, one in Red holding a personal best on a route with a climb steeper than 12%. Fake Trainer on and the mock power meter available, so four equipment slots fill without hardware. Test on the phone first, then repeat the tablet steps each check names.

bench: A phone and a tablet on the candidate
The other platform's build on a phone and a tablet
before: Two riders in the household, one in **Red** and one in **Orange**.

On Android, before the tablet gets the release candidate, start a structured Power workout on the build it has and screenshot the cockpit. iOS has no earlier build to screenshot. Then install the candidate on a phone under 600 dp wide and on the tablet. Start on the phone.

later.text: Settings → Developer · Trainer: **Use mock trainer** on, restart. Mock Wahoo KICKR, Mock Power Meter in Power Source and Cadence, Mock HRM Strap.
Settings → Developer · Trainer: **Use mock trainer** off, quit and reopen. Forget Power Source and Cadence. Bind the real KICKR and the strap.
Import a copy of a demo rider export with its riderColor field removed.
As the Red rider, ride Alpe d'Huez, or another bundled route with a climb over 12 %, so a personal-best ghost exists.
Use the iPhone SE (3rd generation) simulator, 375 × 667 pt, on the release candidate.
Set the largest text: Android Settings → Display → Font size, or iOS Larger Text at the largest size. Set it back afterwards.
Import `demo-dave` from Demo Data as a third rider. He has 18 saved rides.
On the phone, switch to dark theme. **Use mock trainer** off, restart. The real KICKR in Smart Trainer; forget Heart Rate, Power Source and Cadence.
